play_name: Watch over time, then decide to invest
behavioral_target: Waiting to see if the relationship holds up, without setting a point to decide.
trigger: You are getting more serious but are not sure it will last.
old_play: You keep waiting to see if it holds up over time.
function_of_old_play: Waiting gives you more time before you have to fully invest or decide.
new_play: Name what you need to see and by when. Keep showing up while you watch. Then decide.
what_to_expect: You may have to sit with not knowing, then make a real choice — to invest more or to step back.
why_supports_task: It turns waiting into real evaluation, so you can choose to invest on purpose.
maintaining_behaviors_consolidated: Waiting to see if the relationship holds up over time
context_limitations: Watching over time is healthy. This only helps if waiting has become an endless stall with no decision.
review_reason: Single context-dependent behavior; alternative is conditional on waiting having become an indefinite stall.
